node.opening: There may be another survivor group moving near our territory.
node.details: Different reports mention blue trail markers and two scouts avoiding the main road.
node.personal: I don't like unknown people learning our routines before we learn theirs.
node.followup: We need information without advertising where everyone sleeps.
node.closing: First contact could become trade, recruitment, or a fight.
choice.personal: Is this bringing back something bad?
choice.press: Which signs are real and which are rumor?
choice.reassure: The community will face them together.
response.detail.open: Blue cloth at turns, small boot prints, and no campfire smoke.
response.detail.guarded: The markers are real. Their numbers and intentions are not.
response.personal.open: Yes. I've seen friendly arrivals become armed demands.
response.personal.guarded: Old history. We have a current problem.
response.offer_help.open: Take one partner and report back before making contact.
response.offer_help.guarded: Scout only. Curiosity is not permission to negotiate.
response.press.open: The route and markers were confirmed separately. The rest is noise.
response.press.guarded: Treat every unconfirmed detail as false until it isn't.
response.reassure.open: That's why this place is worth protecting.
response.reassure.guarded: Together only works if everyone follows the plan.
response.challenge.open: Agreed. Caution gives us time to discover intent.
response.advice.open: Neutral ground, visible hands, hidden overwatch, and one calm speaker.
response.advice.guarded: Keep distance and never reveal our full numbers.
response.wrap_up.open: Waiting one more day may give us a clearer picture.
response.promise.open: I trust you to remember what is at stake.
response.promise.guarded: Make sure your actions match that promise.
locked.personal: They are not familiar enough with you to discuss that.
locked.skill: You need more Foraging experience to compare the reported signs.
locked.personality: Their personality makes that challenge likely to backfire.
locked.promise: They need more approval before trusting that promise.
